text:
Alex K: Quick FYI — I ran the weekly link-smoke for the model-onboarding runbook and found 4x 404s under the 'data-storage' and 's3-credentials' subsections.
Maria S: D'oh. Do you have the exact paths so I can q&d check?
Alex K: Pasting the failing endpoint list below — reproduced locally with curl.
Alex K: ```
$ curl -I https://docs.redwood.ai/model-onboarding/data-storage#bucket-path
HTTP/2 404
content-type: text/html; charset=utf-8

$ curl -I https://docs.redwood.ai/model-onboarding/s3-credentials#client-config
HTTP/2 404
```
Jen L: thanks — any idea if these were renamed or deleted during the recent restructure?
Praveen R: Looks like a frontmatter slug change in the tutorial repo from last week. There was an automated move: `data-pipeline` -> `data-storage`. Might be anchor mismatch.
docs-bot: Automated link-scan results uploaded to /internal/reports/link-smoke/2150001234 — 4 failures, risk=low.
Maria S: OK — sounds like two options: (A) restore the old anchors with redirects, or (B) update runbook links to the new anchors. Preference?
Alex K: Prefer (B) if anchors are stable in canonical repo. I can open a tiny PR to update the two links in the runbook.
Jen L: I can own the redirects if we want backward compatibility (small nginx redirect or shortlink). But updating runbook is faster.
Praveen R: If the canonical source is the tutorial repo, please change runbook links and add a short note in the PR linking the commit that changed the slugs so we don't flip back.
Maria S: SG. Can you also add a smoke test tweak so the next weekly scan asserts 200s for those endpoints? A one-liner test would do.
Alex K: Yup. Example snippet I'll include in the PR:
Alex K: ```bash
# quick smoke: expect 200
for url in "https://docs.redwood.ai/model-onboarding/data-storage" "https://docs.redwood.ai/model-onboarding/s3-credentials"; do
  status=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' $url)
  [ "$status" = "200" ] || echo "FAIL: $url -> $status"
done
```
Jen L: @Maria S — should we tag @platform-infra for a redirect if we go that route?
Maria S: Yes, please CC platform-infra in the PR if you add redirects. For this small fix let's update runbook links and include the smoke assertion.
Alex K: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/542 (draft) — contains 2 link fixes + one test tweak. Assigning to @Maria S and @Jen L for review.
Jen L: I'll take the redirects follow-up if we need it.
Praveen R: Thanks — once merged, I'll follow up with a short post in #engineering about the slug change so other consumers aren't surprised.
Maria S: Awesome. Thanks Alex for catching this. :thumbsup:
Alex K: np — will update here when PR merges.
Alex K: (update) PR merged 2150001315 — links fixed and smoke test added.
Maria S: Verified locally, all good. Marking this resolved. :white_check_mark:
